title: Austin Local Corp. OKs $5.1M Budget
meeting_type: Mueller Local Government Corporation (MLGC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:
*   Muller Local Government Corporation greenlit its Fiscal Year 2024-2025 operating budget, totaling over $5.1 million.
*   The MLGC board also formally approved its August 2023 meeting minutes.
*   Separately, the Austin Housing Finance Corporation board adopted two consent agenda items during its brief session.
